Analog montage of silk screen motive
The Summer School of the van Eyck Academy in Maastricht dealt with the design
of universal and timeless sign systems. For this we gave the participants the task
to think about the possibilities of a warning system for a nuclear repository, i.e. a
sign system that works both now and in 100,000 years. Over the seven days of
the workshop, the age for which the warning system should be designed became
shorter and shorter (100,000 on the first day, 10,000 on the second, etc.) until it
reached zero hour on the last day - the day of the presentation. The results of the
workshop were documented in a publication and buried in a time capsule in the
garden of the Jan van Eyck Academy.
Logos to be printed over all print results with invisible ink. By Amy Sudo Wu.
